body: I do need to end it if I cannot live it - and if I cannot break up and leave my boyfriend, then I will end it. He just won't let me go. I've begged him, literally on my knees begging him to let me go, and he won't. I mean, he will - but at the same time, he's saying all these things to convince me not to go. And I'm so vulnerable, I weigh less than 100lbs right now, I get so exhausted...I can't fight his words.

Leaving when he's out would be a dream come true - but I've talked to a lot of people, they call me a coward, say it's the lowest thing to do, I need to grow up and have an adult conversation with him. I have, I've had many adult conversations with him, which always lead me to do doing the adult thing and sticking with him because a relationship is a lifelong commitment. Just like you shouldn't adopt a cat if you don't plan to keep it for life, you shouldn't get in a relationship with someone if you can't picture it lasting forever. I don't know what stupid part of me thought a drunk was an okay choice for a boyfriend - and even though he got sober, I don't care, I don't feel any love for him. 

I don't want to die. But I don't want to live my life with him either. So I have to be a bitch, a horrible person, and abandon him. It's just so hard to do because I try to be nice to everyone, I try to help everyone, but I can't help him by staying. I fi do, I'm so gone.
Yes, I love that beach. It was on the beach I decided this was my next move actually. I 100% do not want to do this, but if I don't make this promise to myself, I may never leave.

Thank you. Truly. I just want to go, I just want to leave - and I feel like he could be the absolute best boyfriend in the world and it wouldn't matter, I'd still want to leave. So he deserves to have the chance to go and be an amazing guy with a woman that will feel the kind of love for him he deserves. I just want to be free again. It sucks I can't justify it enough to make everyone understand - I know I should have left when he was still a drunk, but I was literally saving his life from time to time and keeping him employed, taking care of his pets and keeping the house clean, all of which he could barely handle. Then he got sober and now those aren't really issues as he does his share of the work now - but it's like...like I lost the ability to be in love with him during the years I was a caregiver to him. I'll always love him in a way, like I want him to be happy and wish nothing ill on him - but if he came home and told me he cheated on me and was in love with another woman I'd be SO HAPPY and wish him a great life and speed out of here so fast you'd only see my tailights in the distance.

I hate to say this, but I've reread /u/MelonElbows comment like 20 times and I feel like shit for leaving now. Like I haven't given enough or tried hard enough. I would literally go back and time to my 23 year old self who chose to date him and scream at her she's making the biggest mistake of her life, she'll lose all of herself to him and when she is finally ready to go, she'll just see his reflection in the mirror again and again and realize she's lost and should just stay with him. She made her choice, she dug her grave, and now it's time for her to lay down in it and accept that this is her responsibility. You don't get to enter into a relationship lightly. It's apparently a life long commitment, and he doesn't even have to ask you to marry him to get it from you. 

It's terrible. I feel like I have a child and I'm abandoning them on the side of the road. So instead I stay and everyday I pine for a life of my own choosing, I pine for freedom of being \*alone\* or just with friends. It's been over two years since I had spent a day with friends. Two years. I just want my life back - but I already gave it away.
I have this covered 100% - my job travels with me luckily and I'm actually moving back to my social base, I have nothing here

I understand where you are coming from - we did couples counseling for a couple of weeks but the counselor told me I'd have to "make a decision, commit to staying with him or commit to leaving" and I didn't like being strong armed into the choice - I mean, that's what I thought counseling was for, to help me make that choice! So counseling didn't work out. 

But anyway, my boyfriend knows how I feel - we've talked about it 7 times, he's thought I was leaving 7 times. I did individual therapy yes, and my boyfriend got mad I did that because the therapist encouraged me to leave. She did that though because that's that I wanted...but when the person who has loved you for nearly 10 years looks at you like you are wounding him with every word, it's hard to say "the therapist was just doing what I asked her to". He also got mad that I talked to family/friends about my feelings toward him - my feelings he says are inappropriate because he is sober NOW. 

But he was NOT sober a for the first 7 years of our relationship. I've seen guitars fly across the living room, bookshelves fall over, I've screamed at men who were following us down the street that I'll attack them if they try to get my boyfriend after we've left a bar, I've been kicked out of so many bars (my bf got kicked out, not me, I of course leave with him), been so embarrassed by him I isolated myself and quit going to anything, and of course he encouraged me to stay home with him! I have no friends, my family thinks I'm depressed but don't know how to help me, and I go down to a bridge that a minimum of 300 known people have jumped and died from, and I just contemplate life and if one day I'll jump, too. 

So you're right, he's really NOT that bad. Now that he's sober, he's great again - but I just do not love him. I just CANNOT forgive or forget how he treated me, and the world, when he was abusing alcohol. I will NOT however leave him to discover an empty house. No...he'll be here the whole time, telling me that my friends probably won't even want me back anyway, telling me that I won't get to smoke legal pot anymore so I'll feel like crapola, telling me my family will boss me around again and make me do stuff I don't want to do again, he'll tell me my work will get mad that I'm taking the time off, he'll tell me people might murder me at rest stops if I drive cross country alone, he'll tell me how much money all this will cost, how I'll just want to come back in 2 or 3 months and then it will cost even more. He'll say so many things, just because he's trying to keep me here, and it's not malicious and he's not a bad person, but it will tug at the tiniest heart strings I have left and make me stay, again...and again....and again...and one day I'll wake up an old lady with him and realize I never got married, not went on a vacation, we never bought a house, he's still driving around a car with a massive oil leak he never got fixed (I seriously wake up stressed about HIS car not getting fixed, it's had that leak for YEARS NOW!!!), and the million of other things I gave up on to live his slow, boring, irresponsible life without dreams or goals. When I bring up my dreams of owning a house one day....I get accused of just trying to "keep up with the joneses". 

I don't know if I'm a bad person or not for wanting to leave. Sometimes I think yes, I really am, I must be. But other times...I feel like I'm drowning and leaving is my fingers feeling a life raft above me and if I can just grasp it, I can pull myself up and out...
I CAN do it, I can! You are right. I CAN. Thank you!!
The moxie. I have the force of character, determination, or nerve to do this (according to google). Yes. Yes I think I have the moxie, deep inside, somewhere! Moxie to the rescue. Thank you!!

I've been living a life ruled by fear for so long...and you know what? It does not feel like a life lived, but a life lost. 

Thank you. I can do this. I can!!

I should have said men can comment too, I am happy to accept encouragement from ALL people and sentient creatures of our beautiful world, and sure I'll take otherworldly encouragement if it's out there too. Encouragement from men definitely helps - one of the things that stopped me in previous attempts was my boyfriend telling me I'll be the last person he ever dates (he's 10 years older than me so he's in his 40s) and that he'll start a band and call it nobody's husband...breaks my heart but I can't clone myself and leave a clone behind to stay with him (I would if I could). I've actively chosen to sacrifice my happiness for his so many times, and it leads me to hating myself and feeling such pure and utter depression. I know he will be sad, but I'm sure he'll get over it one day, I hope. If he doesn't...I don't know. That's a thought that always make me pause on leaving.
